A1.justification: Both 17-page PDFs describe the same Ego-Foresight study. Their text, equations, eight figures, and references support reliable comparison. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: Sections 4.2–4.3 report original visuomotor prediction experiments, reinforcement-learning results across 25 tasks, and hyperparameter ablations.

after.justification: Sections 4.2–4.3 retain the original prediction experiments, reinforcement-learning results, and ablations reported in v2.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same agent/environment feature partition, recurrent prediction model, combined reconstruction and critic objective, and motor-babbling procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use Meta-World, Distracting DMC, Hurdle DMC, and BAIR, with identical task coverage and prediction scenarios.

E2.justification: Section 4.3 and Figures 1, 6, and 7 retain the same comparisons of DrQ-v2-EF against DrQ-v2, SEAR, and Dreamer-v3.

E3.justification: Training settings, task budgets, evaluation procedures, and metrics are unchanged. Both retain the same prediction/context lengths, babbling duration, and aggregate scoring thresholds.

E4.justification: The feature-gradient visualizations, tool-integration examples, unseen-trajectory prediction, and hyperparameter ablations in Figures 1, 4, 5, and 8 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions specify five runs with different random seeds per baseline per task and report means and standard deviations in Section 4.3. Uncertainty displays are identical.

E6.justification: The result figures and accompanying numerical and qualitative findings are identical, including the reported improvement over DrQ-v2 on 17 of 25 tasks. No results are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, and objectives in Sections 2–3, including Equations 1–4, are unchanged. No formal results or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusions retain identical claims about self-supervised disentanglement, embodiment adaptation, and improved RL sample efficiency and performance.

C2.justification: Sections 4–5 retain the same interpretations and limitations concerning tool integration, correlated object motion, distracting backgrounds, fixed babbling, RL instability, and computational overhead.

D1.justification: The new acknowledgment on page 13 discloses NVIDIA grant support and use of graphics cards described as 'NVIDIA RTX A6000 Ada.' This newly documents hardware without establishing a change in experimental settings. Existing implementation details and code-access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and bibliography contain the same works and research positioning. Reference entries move across pages without substantive changes.

P1.justification: v3 inserts a short Acknowledgments section between Future Work and References and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific prose and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgment shifts the reference-list layout across pages 13–17. All eight figures, their captions, and the scientific page layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 adds a brief funding and hardware disclosure on page 13, providing limited additional transparency. The scientific exposition, method, evidence, and analysis remain identical; the acknowledgment and reference reflow do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
